title: Complexity-Aware Theory Testing from Bell Witnesses
summary: Bell statistical-strength analyses and complexity-based model selection are usually treated separately. Here we relate them by showing that a witness obtained from a coarse-graining of full Bell trials yields, through data processing, a lower bound on the Kullback-Leibler (KL) distance to a competitor class in terms of the induced witness distribution.
